source.name: FOR SOCCER
source.quote: New York City FC Etihad Airways Travel
source.note: Front-of-jersey table of For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor survey (checked via the Wayback capture of 2026-06-16; the live page answered slowly for scripts). The home shirt is the Excelsior Kit, unveiled 2025-02-12 and worn for the 2025 and 2026 seasons (club launch: https://www.newyorkcityfc.com/news/new-york-city-fc-launches-2025-home-jersey-celebrating-the-team-s-10th-anniversary); its launch story does not name the front sponsor.

source.name: New York City FC – New York City FC and Capital Rx Announce Sleeve Partnership
source.quote: The Capital Rx logo will be featured on the right sleeve of NYCFC First Team kits
source.note: Multi-year deal announced 2024-02-06 (date per PR Newswire's release of the same announcement; the club page itself shows no date). For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor survey confirms Capital Rx on NYCFC's right sleeve for the 2026 season.

source.name: FOR SOCCER
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Etihad Airways fronts the Excelsior Kit, with Capital Rx on the right sleeve.
